title: FTC Demands Anthropic Executives Testify in AI Safety Probe
summary:
Leadership at the AI startup Anthropic must provide testimony to the Federal Trade Commission as part of an expanded probe into consumer harm and AI safety.

The regulatory demand comes as the company is pitching investors for an initial public offering described as one of the largest in history.
